name: StrataOS example catalog
description: A small catalog showing the community catalog format. Not maintained for real use.

apps.name: Whoami
apps.description: Tiny web server that prints information about the request. Handy to test the App Center.
apps.compose:
services:
  whoami:
    image: traefik/whoami:v1.10.4
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${WEB_PORT}:80"

apps.name: IT Tools
apps.description: Collection of handy online tools for developers (encoders, converters, generators).
apps.compose:
services:
  it-tools:
    image: corentinth/it-tools:2024.10.22-7ca5933
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${WEB_PORT}:80"

apps.name: FileBrowser Quantum
apps.description: Web file manager for a folder of your NAS, with its own accounts.
apps.compose:
services:
  filebrowser:
    image: gtstef/filebrowser:0.7.0-beta
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${WEB_PORT}:80"
    volumes:
      - ${FILES_DIR}:/srv
      - ${DATA_DIR}:/home/filebrowser/data

apps.name: Dozzle (community)
apps.description: Live logs of your containers. Reads the Docker socket: it sees and controls every container, so it needs an explicit approval.
apps.compose:
services:
  dozzle:
    image: amir20/dozzle:v8.5.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${WEB_PORT}:8080"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
